people.imagined: In the Pill Room's second furnace room he lifts the lid of a little gourd to smell a wound pill. His sunburn never fades and his wrists are stained green to the cuff. Winter frost-roots lie on the bench.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a jade-topped work bench in a furnace room lit by a soft glow, he holds a small brown gourd under his nose to smell a wound pill and glances up at the viewer, soft-spoken and a little shy, winter frost-roots lying on the bench. Face (most important: a ferryman's sunburn, a permanent deep tan across nose and cheeks, and herb-green stains up to the wrists): a young oval face with ruddy sun-browned cheeks and nose, gentle dark brown eyes, thin brows, a small mouth in a half-smile and a faint dimple. Hair: black, in a loose knot at the crown held by a jade pine-twig hairpin. Body: slim and a little stooped from the bench, narrow in the shoulders. Clothing: layered robes of pale bark-cream silk under a pine-green gauze over-robe with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves folded back to the elbow and held with silk cords, borders embroidered with darker green pine needles and wind-curls, a needle-green silk sash with a small green jade pine-cone pendant. Hands and objects: both hands stained green to the wrist; in them a small round brown gourd with a wooden stopper; on the bench a row of tiny clay jars, a few frost-roots and a little bronze pill furnace. Power: a few faint green motes of wood qi drift up from the herbs and settle in his sleeves. Background: a dark furnace room softly blurred, with a warm red glow and curling pale mist at the back. Light: soft red furnace glow from the lower right and a cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim along his shoulder so the sunburn glows on his nose. Expression: a humble, patient, kindly face, the half-smile hesitant and the eyes lowered then lifted, the look of a man who would rather be useful than noticed.

people.imagined: A hard clear morning on the training ground. She has just won another duel and does not smile about it. Her father's black blade rides across her back.
people.subject: The moment: tall and upright on a bare stone terrace in a clear pale dawn, she looks straight at the viewer with her chin raised, having just won another duel and not smiling about it. Face (most important: a long black flying blade across her back, its hilt and a hand's length of scabbard clearly at her shoulder, her father's): a sharp-featured narrow face with high cheekbones, a long straight nose, strongly straight black brows, narrow dark eyes with a level, challenging stare, a thin firm mouth and a small scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, drawn tight into a high tail with a green silk cord, a jade pine-twig hairpin at the base. Body: tall, long-limbed, fit and straight as a post. Clothing: a close-cut robe of pine-green silk with a standing collar and a pale cream inner collar showing, narrow sleeves banded with silver-embroidered pine needles, a needle-green sash with a second narrow green cord and a small jade pine-cone pendant, long gauze panels falling behind her like pine boughs. Hands and objects: one hand resting on the pommel of the black blade over her shoulder, a small knot of grey cord tied on the scabbard. Power: a taut pale green current of wood qi curls along her sleeve and the black scabbard, a few leaf-shaped motes of light lifting off her shoulders. Background: a luminous pale dawn sky with drifting mist and a few dark pine tops. Light: cool silver morning light from the upper left, sharp on the cheekbone, a bright green rim along the black scabbard. Expression: proud and unsmiling, the mouth a thin straight line, the stare steady and cool, the look of a woman who expects to win and expects it to be noticed.

people.imagined: Alone in the Hall of Voices he is mid-song, the long chronicle running in his deep voice, his lips moving even as he listens to the echo.
people.subject: The moment: alone in the Hall of Voices, seated cross-legged, he sings the long chronicle with his mouth open and his head tilted slightly back, then lowers his eyes to the viewer. Face (most important: a bald head and a deep chest, a small frame with a big voice): a thin lined face with a smooth, tanned, shiny bald scalp, large ears flat against the skull, fine veins at the temples, a long grey-white beard split into two thin braids, heavy lids, dark patient eyes and a wide mouth open in song with the lips rounded. Hair: bald, with only a few white eyebrow hairs. Body: thin, narrow-chested and upright, the throat swelling slightly with the note. Clothing: an elder's layered robes of pale bark-cream silk under a grey-green gauze over-robe, three crossed collars, wide sleeves pooling on the floor around him, borders embroidered in dark green pine needles and wind-curls, a grey-green silk sash fastened with a small jade pine-cone toggle. Hands and objects: both hands laid on his knees; a small carved pine-cone clapper of pale green wood on the floor beside him. Power: faint pale-green ripples of wood qi spread across the floor from his voice, like rings on still water, with a few soft motes drifting upward. Background: a dim hall of tall pillars with a long floor of pale boards that carries the echo, drifting mist and a single low lamp. Light: soft low lamplight from the upper left putting a gold sheen on his scalp, a gentle silver glow in the mist behind. Expression: a deep, patient absorption, the eyes lowered and the whole face given to the sound, honest and withdrawn, listening to his own echo.

people.imagined: In the outer gate yard, with a hundred children before her, she calls across the whole yard without raising her voice. A pine-cone pin holds her hair.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bright misty yard with one arm lifted as if signalling a class, she turns her face to the viewer with a brisk, warm smile, a hundred children blurred behind her. Face: an alert round face with strong cheekbones, quick dark eyes with laugh lines, neat straight black brows, a wide mouth with the corners lifted and a little sweat at the temples from calling across the yard all morning. Hair: black with a few grey strands, in a tight bun held by a large pine-cone hairpin of green jade. Body: compact, brisk, straight-backed, strong shoulders. Clothing: layered robes of pale bark-cream silk under a grey-green gauze over-robe as befits a steward, two crossed collars, the wide sleeves held back by two grey-green silk cords crossed at the back, borders embroidered with pine needles and wind-curls, a grey-green sash with a small bag of pine nuts in green brocade hung from it. Hands and objects: the right hand raised, palm out in a class signal; the left holds a long thin teaching rod of pale pine with a jade tip. Power: a light breath of green wood qi follows her raised hand, a few pale motes drifting over the children's heads. Background: a long yard of cross-legged children in soft cream robes, softly blurred, tall pines and a low line of roofs wreathed in morning mist. Light: bright pearly morning light from the upper left with a soft green glow in the mist, a clean rim light on her sleeve. Expression: a brisk, warm smile with bright steady eyes and a lifted chin, the face of someone used to being heard across a yard.

people.imagined: Late at night he sits with a cup he has not yet drunk and a fresh bruise on his forearm. He is trying to find the one sober dusk in which to say what he heard.
people.subject: The moment: late at night he sits slumped on a bench with a small empty cup in both hands, and looks up slowly at the viewer with red-rimmed eyes, trying to find the one sober dusk in which to say what he heard. Face (most important: a drinker's red nose and a purple-yellow bruise on the left cheekbone): a heavy, square, tired face, a big bulbous red nose with fine broken veins, a fresh bruise on the left cheek, thick grey-flecked brows, sad small brown eyes with sagging lower lids, a drooping mouth, a short stubbly beard mixed grey and brown with a nick on the chin. Hair: dark brown going grey, short and messy. Body: heavy, broad and slumped, thick neck. Clothing: a rumpled but clean robe of pine-green silk with a loosened cream inner collar and two crossed collars, the wide sleeves pushed back, a missing toggle replaced by a bit of green silk cord, a needle-green sash with a small round bronze token on a cord at his neck, smooth and dull from his thumb, faded pine-needle embroidery on the hems. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round an empty clay cup; another bruise on the left wrist. Power: a thin, sluggish wisp of green wood qi hangs about his shoulders and sinks, as if too tired to rise. Background: a dim hall with a single lantern and drifting pale smoke, a bench along a wall holding a row of cups, one overturned. Light: low amber lamplight from the upper left making the bruise look darker, a faint cold silver rim from a window behind him. Expression: heavy, red-rimmed eyes lifted slowly to the viewer, the mouth pressed shut as if swallowing words, brows drawn in.

people.imagined: In the mess he roars a joke across the tables. The whole room knows he has arrived. He is grinning at the person he is about to shout at.
people.subject: The moment: mid-shout in a crowded lantern-lit hall, his mouth wide open and his chin forward, he leans toward the viewer with a swaggering grin, grinning at the person he is about to shout at. Face (most important: a huge open shouting mouth with a square jaw): a broad, brutal, ruddy face with a thick jaw, a wide-open mouth with strong yellow teeth, a flattened nose, small gleaming eyes, thick eyebrows raised high and a cattle-herder's weathered cheeks, a scar cutting through the left eyebrow, ears sticking out under the cropped hair, a vein standing out in his thick neck. Hair: close-cropped black, with a cowlick. Body: big, thick-necked and broad. Clothing: a robe of pine-green silk with the collars thrown open to show a broad chest, a needle-green silk sash tied loosely, wide sleeves shoved up the forearm and held by a polished green-lacquered bracer, pale cream inner collars rumpled, pine-needle embroidery on the hems, a rough wooden cattle bell on a cord at his throat. Hands and objects: one fist hammering on a table; the other hand holding a cup of jade-green glaze half raised. Power: a brash gust of green wood qi tosses the hair of those nearest him and sends a few bright motes spinning from his shout. Background: a noisy hall of long tables and warm paper lanterns, figures blurred in a haze of pale smoke. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left with a sheen of sweat on his brow, a soft jade rim along his shoulder. Expression: a swaggering grin, eyes glinting with relish and the chin thrust forward.

people.imagined: On the practice range, he holds a bow up to his ear and tests the string against his puckered left ear before he trusts it. A row of boys waits behind.
people.subject: The moment: on a misty practice range at first light he holds a bow beside his face and touches the bowstring to his left ear, listening, looking at the viewer from the corner of his eye, a row of boys waiting behind him. Face (most important: a puckered, scarred left ear where the string touches it): a lean, hard, sunburnt face with a long nose, a firm thin mouth chapped by wind, hooded dark eyes creased in a squint, crow's feet and a short grey stubble; the left ear thick and puckered with pale scar tissue. Hair: black streaked with grey, cut short, a jade pine-twig pin in a small knot. Body: lean, wiry and stiff-backed. Clothing: a fitted robe of pine-green silk with a stiff standing collar over cream inner collars, long sleeves narrowed at the wrist by arm guards of dark horn plates laced with green cord, a needle-green sash, a quiver strap crossing the chest, silver-thread pine needles stitched along the collar. Hands and objects: a long plain bow of dark wood held at the face, the string plucked by one finger against his ear; a quiver of grey-feathered arrows at the shoulder. Power: a pale ribbon of green qi winds once along the bowstring and trembles, a few motes shivering off it. Background: a pale field with straw targets in a long row, a rope marking the firing line, drifting dawn mist. Light: clear silver morning light from the upper left slanting across the bow and the grain of the dark wood, a bright rim along his jaw. Expression: a calm, exacting face with one eye narrowed and the head cocked to the string, the mouth set level and unmoved.

people.imagined: She brings a ferry about hard and laughs; passengers grip the rail. A coin is flipped on the gunwale to decide who boards.
people.subject: The moment: at the steering sweep of a ferry on a wide shining river, she throws her head back laughing, a copper coin flashing in the air above her hand, passengers gripping the rail behind her. Face (most important: a huge laughing mouth and a coin spinning above her fingers): a round, wind-tanned, handsome face with a wide laughing mouth, strong white teeth, bright dark eyes narrowed in mirth, thick brows and gold-brown skin with freckles, fine laugh lines fanning from the outer corners of her eyes. Hair: black, in a long braid thrown over one shoulder with a jade pine-twig pin, blown by the wind. Body: sturdy and muscular in the shoulders. Clothing: a pine-green silk coat over pale cream layers with two crossed collars, the sleeves tied back with green silk cords so that the wide cuffs stream behind, a needle-green sash with a small bone toggle, a faded blue silk scarf knotted at her throat, borders embroidered with wind-curls and waves. Hands and objects: the right hand has just flipped a small copper coin that glints above it; the left holds the long wooden steering sweep. Power: a cool pale-blue shimmer of water qi runs along the sweep and the wake, tiny drops of light flying up with her laugh. Background: the ferry's wooden rail curving in the foreground with a few passengers, blurred, and a far bank as a pale line in mist. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left sparkling on the water, glints on the coin and her teeth, a soft rim along her braid. Expression: a head-back laugh with a wide open mouth, crinkled eyes and flushed cheeks.

people.imagined: On the dike in spring he walks with the flood-mark rod and leans on it only when he thinks nobody is looking.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a misty dike in spring with a tall marked rod in his right hand, he leans on it slightly and glances at the viewer, catching himself as if he thought nobody was looking. Face (most important: a tall pale pole banded with dark painted rings, the flood-mark rod): a long, weathered face with a hooked nose, a deep line on each cheek, a small moustache, grey-streaked brows, tired but watchful grey eyes, a firm jaw, grey stubble on the chin and sun-blotches at the temples. Hair: grey and black, in a small knot with a jade pine-twig pin. Body: tall, bony and slightly lopsided from a stiff leg. Clothing: an elder steward's layered robes of pale cream silk under a grey-green gauze over-robe, the hem darkened by water, cords wound in neat spirals round the lower sleeves, a grey-green sash, borders of wind-curls and pine needles in darker green, a broad flat straw hat hanging behind his shoulder on its cord. Hands and objects: the tall pale wooden rod as tall as himself banded with dark painted rings; the left hand holds a coil of rope. Power: a faint pale-blue breath of water qi gathers around the rings of the rod and over the wet grass, a few pale motes rising like river-mist. Background: a grassy dike with a row of numbered posts, the river beyond under a pearl-grey sky, and a heron standing in the shallows. Light: cool pearl-grey spirit-light from the upper left, making the wet mud shine and the painted rings stand out. Expression: a quiet, cautious pride, the mouth firm and the eyes tired and watchful, a stubborn diligence he does not admit to.

people.imagined: He walks the landing bent as if over a pan, scanning the ground for something dropped. He remembers the burning ferries.
people.subject: The moment: on a muddy landing at dusk he stands slightly stooped, head down and forward, eyes scanning the ground, then looks up sharply at the viewer, still searching for something dropped and remembering the burning ferries. Face (most important: a stooped forward-bent back and a downward searching gaze): a lean, sun-hardened face with hollow cheeks, a long nose, deep-set dark eyes, thick brows pulled together, a tight vengeful mouth, a straggly black moustache, a small scar on the chin and a long old burn scar down the left side of the neck. Hair: black, tied in a tail with a faded green silk cord. Body: stooped, with the shoulders rounded forward and long arms. Clothing: a river-faded pine-green silk coat over cream layers, collars crossed twice, the hem wet from the shallows, the sleeves rolled, a green sash and a small pouch of rust-brown nails at the belt stitched with thick black thread, faded wave embroidery along the cuffs. Hands and objects: one hand holds out a bent iron nail between two fingers; the other hangs low. Power: a slow pale-blue haze of water qi clings to his ankles and the wet stakes, drifting after his gaze. Background: a muddy riverbank with a line of small pale wooden stakes along it, a flat-bottomed boat pulled up with a pan leaning against it, thin mist over the water. Light: cold silver dusk light from the upper left, flat except for a faint gleam on the wet mud and the iron nail, a pale rim on his scarred neck. Expression: a hard, brooding gaze with a long memory behind the eyes, the mouth tight and the brows drawn, patient as a man who intends to wait years for his answer.

people.imagined: Entering a room, she counts the people before she speaks, the cord wound round her wrist moving with each count.
people.subject: The moment: at the doorway of a lamplit hall, her eyes flick left to right as if counting the people in the room before she speaks, a cord wound several times round her wrist moving with each count. Face: a narrow, pale, watchful face with a high forehead, level alert dark eyes, thin straight brows, a small precise mouth held shut, finely drawn thin lips, a slight pinch at the nostrils, a tiny vertical line between the brows and a small scar above the left eyebrow. Hair: black, smoothed back into a tight bun with a jade pine-twig pin and a single pearl. Body: slight, upright and neat. Clothing: closely tailored layered robes of grey-green silk over pale cream, two crossed collars, narrow sleeves buttoned at the wrist with tiny pearls, a grey-green sash as a steward, a small bag of pearl-grey silk at the belt with a drawstring of blue thread, borders embroidered with pine needles and ripples. Hands and objects (the cord is the lead): a long knotted tally-cord of pale blue thread wound five times round her left wrist, tiny white pearls tied along it; the right hand lifted a little with one finger raised as if counting. Power: a faint blue-white shimmer of water qi lies along the cord and trembles with each count, tiny motes pearling in the air. Background: a long lamplit hall with low tables and cushions and a few figures standing and sitting in rows, softly blurred in a faint mist. Light: soft lamplight from the upper left throwing her shadow tall on the wall and gleaming on the pearls, a pale silver rim on her cheek. Expression: a flat, exact, watchful look, the mouth closed and the eyes moving, the composure of someone who trusts only what she has counted herself.

people.imagined: She comes in from the lake smelling of lamp-oil and fish, one bright ribbon in her plain braid; she is counting her allowance in her head for her brother.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a lake shore at dusk with a basket on her hip, she looks at the viewer with an easy, warm smile, just in from the lake smelling of lamp oil and fish and counting her allowance in her head for her brother. Face (most important: one very bright scarlet ribbon tied in an otherwise plain braid): a round, sun-warmed face with a small straight nose, cheerful dark eyes, rosy cheeks, fine freckles, thick soft brows, a faint peel of sunburn on the nose and a calm, content mouth. Hair: black, in one long braid over the shoulder, the bright scarlet ribbon tied at the end and a jade pine-twig pin at the top. Body: sturdy and soft, comfortable in herself. Clothing: pine-green silk robes over pale cream with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied up with silk cord, a needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant, a fish-scale shimmer along one cuff, a little jade fish toggle at the neck and a blue-thread stitch at the left elbow, borders of wave-curls and pine needles. Hands and objects: a flat reed basket on her left hip holding two silver fish and a small brass lamp with a glass chimney. Power: a soft pale-blue breath of water qi lifts off the lake and winds round her ankles, a few silver motes at her hem. Background: a lake at dusk with small boats carrying tiny lanterns rocking on dark water and the far shore a low line with a few lit windows, mist on the water. Light: soft gold dusk light from the upper left, warm on her cheek and picking out the bright red of the ribbon, a silver glow off the lake. Expression: calm, content and generous, a relaxed half-smile and warm eyes, a girl comfortable in a plain life and glad to share what she has.

people.imagined: In the Array Hall's back room she draws an array in the air with one finger while talking, planting flags one by one for the crossing she was asked to lay.
people.subject: The moment: in the Array Hall's back room she speaks to the viewer while one forefinger traces a line in the air, her eyes on it, planting flags one by one for the crossing she was asked to lay. Face (most important: the index finger, held up and tracing a faint glowing line in the air): a narrow, intelligent, sharp face with a long chin, high cheekbones, bright restless dark eyes, a firm thin mouth, small close-set ears, a line between the brows and a streak of white chalk across the knuckles of the raised hand; a thin trail of pale green light hangs where her finger moved. Hair: black, in a neat high bun fastened with two jade pine twigs crossed. Body: slim, quick and upright. Clothing: close-fitting layered robes of pine-green silk with three crossed collars over cream, narrow sleeves edged in a strip of sky-blue silk, a needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant, a pouch of small flags at the belt with their pale poles showing, borders of silver-thread pine needles and wind-curls, a grey-green gauze half-cape over one shoulder as the chosen successor. Hands and objects: the right forefinger extended mid-air; the left hand holds three small triangular green flags on short poles. Power: soft green wood qi and a few pale blue motes of water qi stream off her fingertip into a half-drawn lattice of light hanging in the air. Background: a back room with white chalk lines crossing the floor, small stones at the corners of a half-drawn figure, a lamp, a window of pale mist. Light: pale spirit-light from the upper left, with the green trail casting a faint green shine on her cheek and hand. Expression: absorbed and exact, the lips pressed and the eyes bright, a quick ambition held in check by the need to finish the line correctly.

people.imagined: He has just lost a go game, chalk on his sleeve, one shoe untied. He sits back, calm and lazy, planning the array he will draw now.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a go board in a quiet evening room, he leans back with a lazy smile after losing a game, one shoe visibly untied beside him, already planning the array he will draw next. Face: a long, relaxed, boyish face with a lopsided easy smile, heavy-lidded dark eyes, thick tilted brows, a stubbly chin, a small gap between the teeth and a smudge of white chalk on the cheek and across the forehead where he scratched it. Hair: dark brown and messy, in a loose knot with a jade pine twig that has slipped. Body: tall, loose-limbed and slouched. Clothing: layered robes of pine-green silk over cream, the collars crossed carelessly, a long ink-and-chalk stain down the left sleeve, a needle-green sash tied askew with a lopsided knot, white chalk dust on the sleeves and knees, the hem trailing untidily over a bare ankle, faint pine-needle embroidery on the borders. Hands and objects: a white go stone held lightly between two chalk-dusted fingers; the board in front of him with a loose scatter of black and white stones; one shoe lying untied at his foot, laces trailing. Power: a few idle green motes of wood qi drift above the board and settle on the stones like pollen. Background: a plain wooden room with a low table, a paper window glowing with moon-mist and a teacup pushed to the table's edge. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left across the board, lighting the chalk dust floating in the air, a soft silver moonlight rim along his shoulder. Expression: a lazy, unbothered smile with the eyelids half lowered, the calm of a man who treats losing as the first move of a longer plan.

people.imagined: She grinds agarwood in a stone mortar in a haze of smoke; the palace cats have followed her in and sit round her feet.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim, smoky room she grinds agarwood resin in a stone mortar, smoke curling around her, and a grey cat sits at her elbow while another curls at her feet; she looks up at the viewer serenely. Face: a soft oval face with smooth fair skin, gentle slanted dark eyes half closed in calm, a straight small nose, a quiet mouth, one fine line across the forehead, a tiny spot of brown resin at the corner of her mouth and a veil of pale smoke at her cheek. Hair: black, loose and long, tied low with a green silk strip and a jade pine-twig pin; smoke clings to it. Body: slender and calm. Clothing: layered robes of pine-green silk over pale cream with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied up with green cord and dusted with brown powder to the elbow, a needle-green sash from which a small jade spoon and a brush hang, a sprig of dried herb tucked in the collar, borders of pine needles and curling smoke patterns. Hands and objects: both hands on a stone pestle grinding dark resin in a stone mortar; thin grey smoke spirals from a small brazier beside; a grey cat sitting at her side. Power: gentle green wood qi braids with the incense smoke, a few warm motes of ember glowing in the haze. Background: shelves of small labelled jars glowing faintly behind her, a low charcoal brazier beside a cat's tail, soft smoke. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, a gold haze of smoke softening everything and making her sleeves glow at the edges. Expression: a serene, soft face with lowered lids lifting slowly to the viewer, lips relaxed in a faint smile.

people.imagined: At the water's edge he repeats every instruction twice under his breath. His stammer eases with the tide at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: standing knee-deep at the edge of a shallow tide with his lips moving, he looks up at the viewer with earnest anxious eyes, repeating each instruction twice under his breath, his stammer easing with the tide at his feet. Face (most important: moving lips, whispering to himself, a worried earnest look): a young, thin, serious face with wide anxious grey-brown eyes, light brows slanted upward in the middle, a slightly open mouth caught mid-whisper, pale skin, a wind-reddened nose, pink ears from the cold and salt on his lashes. Hair: dark, damp from sea spray, tied in a short knot with a jade pine-twig pin. Body: slight and a little hunched, the hems lifted out of the water. Clothing: layered robes of pine-green silk over cream, the lower layers darkened by the tide to the knee, two crossed collars, a needle-green silk sash come loose with one long strand trailing in the water, the wide sleeves rolled, bare feet in the shallows, borders of wave-curls and pine needles in darker green. Hands and objects: both hands held flat at the waist, palms down over the water as if holding the tide; a small pearly seashell tied on a cord at his neck. Power: a soft pale-blue water qi rises from the shallows in slow rings around his palms, a few silver motes rising with each whispered word. Background: a silver-grey sea with a long low tide-line and a pale horizon, small waves lapping his legs, a line of wet pebbles and a half-sunk post in the mist. Light: soft moonlit grey light from the upper left, a wet shine on his hair and the shell at his neck, a pale rim along his cheek. Expression: an anxious, devout earnestness, the brows tilted and the lips moving silently, patient and withdrawn, a man at his calmest when he is alone with the water.

people.imagined: At the first furnace she hums the same three notes. Her fringe is singed short and she teases the man at the next furnace about his frost-roots.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a furnace, she hums the same three notes with her chin up and turns a sly glance on the viewer, a small ladle in her hand, teasing the man at the next furnace about his frost-roots. Face (most important: a singed short fringe, scorched brown at the ends): a pert, sharp face with a snub nose, quick dark eyes with a hard shine, thin brows, a wide half-smiling mouth, lips slightly parted for the hum, a smut of ash on the cheek, a smudge of soot on the chin and scorched ends of hair over the forehead. Hair: black, in a high tail with a green silk cord and a jade pine-twig pin, the front fringe cropped short and burnt uneven. Body: small, strong and brisk. Clothing: layered robes of pine-green silk over pale cream with two crossed collars, a needle-green sash, the wide sleeves tied back with two cords, a smoke-grey silk over-apron scorched at the hem with a small burnt spot near the hip, a little jade ladle hanging from the belt, borders of pine needles and flame-curls. Hands and objects: a long wooden ladle in the right hand resting over a glowing furnace mouth; a clay jar of pill paste in the left. Power: soft green wood qi laced with a spark of warm ember motes coils from the furnace into her hair and sleeves. Background: a red-lit furnace room with shelves of clay jars along the wall, a pot bubbling on a low stove, a bundle of dried herbs hanging from a beam, curls of pale mist. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower right, gleaming on her cheek and the tip of the ladle, a cool silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a sly, impatient grin with a flicker of mischief, the glance sideways quick and the mouth tugging up, a girl who finds other people's slowness faintly funny.

people.imagined: At his counting desk in the resin town he tilts his ledger away from a passer-by; a thumb gilded with resin pitch rests on the page.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a counting desk in a resin shop, he tilts a ledger book on edge away from the viewer with one arm curled round it, eyes wary. Face (most important: a thumb gilded amber with sticky resin, held up against the ledger edge): a round, smooth, plump face with small shrewd eyes, a thin moustache, soft cheeks, a tight smile, a drop of amber resin on his chin, tiny droplets of amber clinging to his moustache and a faint shine of sweat on his upper lip. Hair: oiled black, in a tidy knot under a flat black silk cap with a jade pine-twig pin. Body: soft and round, sitting forward. Clothing: layered robes of grey-green silk over cream as a clerk, two crossed collars, a row of small ivory buttons down a pine-green vest, black silk cuff-guards over the wide sleeves, a grey-green sash with a copper clasp, borders embroidered with pine needles and wind-curls. Hands and objects: the left arm shielding the open book (no readable writing, only blurred lines); the right thumb pressed to the page, golden and shiny with resin; a small lump of amber on the desk. Power: a faint amber-gold haze rises from the resin and a few green wood-qi motes cling to his sleeve. Background: a shop with barrels and clay pots of resin, a few amber lumps on a scale pan, a ladder to a loft, honey-coloured mist. Light: warm amber light from the upper left turning everything gold and picking out the shine on his thumb, a thin pale rim on his round cheek. Expression: a guarded half-smile with watchful eyes slid toward the viewer, the brow slightly lowered.

people.imagined: On the border fence he chalks a mark on his wrist at each post as he saw the surveyors do. He stands in the wind, stubborn.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a fence post in the wind with a stub of white chalk, he marks his own wrist as he has seen the surveyors do and looks at the viewer with a plain, honest scowl, stubborn. Face (most important: white chalk tally marks drawn in a row on the inside of the left wrist, held up): a square, weathered face with a thick neck, a short broad straight nose, steady brown eyes, a firm jaw with short dark stubble, a chapped lower lip, a long scar on the forehead and sun-creased skin at the neck. Hair: dark brown and short, with a jade pine-twig pin in a little tail. Body: stocky, steady and square, planted in the wind. Clothing: a robe of pine-green silk over cream with two crossed collars, the sleeves cut short at the forearm, a needle-green sash, dark lacquered bracers with brass studs, tough boots with scuffed toes, a silk pouch of chalk sticks at the belt and a coil of survey rope over the shoulder, borders of wind-curls and pine needles. Hands and objects: the left wrist held up with five short parallel white chalk strokes on the skin; the right hand holds the chalk stub. Power: a pale green wood qi sweeps along the fence line in the wind, and a few silver motes of metal qi glint at the chalk-dusted fingertips. Background: a plain wooden fence running over a grey-green hillside with pines and a small cairn of stones, a thin mist lying in the valley. Light: cool clear spirit-light from the upper left, showing the white chalk marks sharply against the brown skin of his wrist, a soft rim along his shoulder. Expression: a plain, honest scowl, the brows low and the jaw set, brave and stubborn, a man who will mark every post himself rather than trust a report.

people.imagined: Warden of the mine, at the mine mouth with green dust in his beard; he smiles slowly at a pine growing out of the rock he has left alone.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a mine mouth, he strokes his beard with one hand and smiles slowly at the viewer, green dust in his beard, a pine growing out of the rock he has left alone. Face (most important: a beard turning green at the roots, plainly bright malachite green near the skin): a broad, lined, kindly face with a heavy brow, small deep-set eyes, a big nose, a grey beard shaded green at the roots, dust in the wrinkles, ruddy cheeks and white brow hairs tipped faintly green. Hair: grey, thin, under a small silk cap tied with green cord and a jade pine-twig pin. Body: broad, a little stooped from the low tunnels. Clothing: an elder's layered robes of pale cream silk under a grey-green gauze over-robe, three crossed collars, the wide sleeves dusted green at the cuffs, a grey-green sash for his rank, a dark silk work-sash, borders embroidered with pine needles and stone-vein patterns, a small brass lamp hung from his belt. Hands and objects: thick scarred hands; the right in the beard; the left holds a small iron pick with a short worn handle and a lump of bright green stone. Power: a silver-white shimmer of metal qi plays on the green stone and a pale green wood qi rises from the lone pine, faint motes drifting in the beard. Background: a dark mine mouth in grey rock with timber props, a cart on rails in the shadow, a single pine beside it, a thin mist. Light: dim spirit-light from the upper left with a green gleam from the stone on his beard roots, a soft glow around the lamp. Expression: a slow, easy smile in the beard, crinkled eyes warm and unhurried, the face weathered and at peace.

people.imagined: At the broken cliff in spring, alone, she calls names into the rubble and waits. A streak of white shows in her black hair.
people.subject: The moment: standing before a broken cliff in spring, alone, her head slightly tilted as if listening for an answer after calling names into the rubble. Face (most important: a bold white streak in her black hair, from the brow back): a composed, pale oval face with gentle level brows, calm dark eyes with a faint wet shine and a little redness, long lashes, a small steady mouth, soft lines at the eyes and a smooth pale forehead. Hair: black with a single broad white streak running from the front hairline back, in a plain low knot with a jade pine-twig pin. Body: slender, still, upright. Clothing: layered robes of pine-green silk of excellent cut over pale cream, three crossed collars, wide sleeves falling to the wrists, a plain pale grey-green silk shawl pinned with a jade pin, a needle-green sash tied in a precise bow, borders of silver-thread pine needles and wind-curls. Hands and objects: both hands folded at her waist holding a little tea bowl of grey stone with a thin curl of steam. Power: a quiet pale green wood qi gathers around her and a few amber motes of earth qi drift up from the rubble like dust remembering the shape of a wall. Background: a broken cliff face of grey rubble, fallen blocks and splintered beams, small wildflowers in the cracks, a pale sky and drifting mist. Light: clear cold moonlight from the upper left lying evenly on the broken stone, giving her white streak a silver sheen, a soft rim on her shoulder. Expression: a calm, tilted face with a still gaze and parted lips, patient and listening, streaked white at the temple.

people.imagined: On the caravan road, he smiles a moment after everyone else's has gone, tallying who would pay for what.
people.subject: The moment: on a caravan road at dusk, he lets a late easy smile slowly spread across his face while looking at the viewer, a moment after everyone else's has gone, tallying who would pay for what. Face: a good-looking, smooth, open face with a high forehead, long lashes, long-lidded bright brown eyes that stay steady, a thin neat moustache, a smooth jaw, a small scar through the left brow, a trace of road dust in the creases of the smile and a sly slow smile. Hair: black, in a tidy knot with a green silk cord and a jade pine-twig pin. Body: tall, easy and relaxed in the saddle. Clothing: a tailored robe of pine-green silk with cream inner collars crossed twice, wide sleeves lined in pale silk, a needle-green sash with a polished brass buckle, a leather riding glove tucked into it, borders embroidered with pine needles and wind-curls in silver thread. Hands and objects: one hand holds a horse's rein; the other lifts a small cup of wine slightly toward the viewer in a salute; a small bell hangs from the saddle. Power: a lazy ribbon of pale green wood qi drifts from his raised cup with a few warm motes of dusk light. Background: a caravan road with a line of canvas-topped wagons and resting oxen blurred behind him, blue-purple hills, dusk mist. Light: low orange evening light from the upper left picking out the rim of the cup and the glint in his eyes, a soft violet rim along his sleeve. Expression: a pleasant, unhurried smile that arrives a beat late, warm on the mouth and entirely calculating in the eyes, an agreeable man who will sell any promise at its price.

people.imagined: She sits on the retreat's top step between sweeps with her broom across her knees, grey hair coming loose, listening to her old master cough at dawn.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stone step in the early morning with a broom of pine twigs across her knees, she looks up at the viewer with gentle patience, grey hair coming loose, listening to her old master cough at dawn. Face (most important: grey hair, pinned loosely, and a blue-grey silk apron): a kind, plain, lined face with a soft round chin, pale grey-brown eyes, warm laugh lines, thin silver brows, a small round mole beside the nose, a quiet small smile and a pine needle caught in the hair. Hair: grey, pinned up in a loose bun with a jade pine-twig pin, a few silver hairs escaping. Body: small, sturdy and round-shouldered, square red hands from work. Clothing: soft old layered robes of pale bark-cream silk under a grey-green gauze over-robe, two crossed collars, a grey-green sash with a bunch of keys on a silk cord at her waist, and over it a blue-grey silk apron dusted with pine needles, faded pine-needle embroidery along the hems. Hands and objects: both hands lie on a broom of bound pine twigs across her lap; a small celadon tea cup stands on the step by her. Power: a soft haze of green wood qi, thin as breath, rises from the pine needles around her feet and clings to her hair, a few motes in the mist. Background: a stone staircase strewn with pine needles and moss, tall trunks, morning mist, a small wooden bucket by the wall and a faint line of smoke from a chimney above. Light: soft pearly light from the upper left making her grey hair glow and picking out the straw of the broom, a silver rim along her shoulder. Expression: a calm, humble, loyal gentleness, the small smile settled and the eyes soft, a woman content to serve the same house for her whole life.

people.imagined: Asleep on a bench with the satchel clutched in his arms like a doll. A boy wakes him and he grins, still holding it.
people.subject: The moment: half-awake on an inn-porch bench, he hugs a leather satchel tight to his chest with both arms and blinks at the viewer with a cheerful sleepy grin, a boy having just woken him. Face (most important: a battered leather satchel hugged in both arms against his chest): a round sunburnt friendly face, a wide mouth with a gap tooth, quick bright eyes with faint dark circles, a small moustache, creases from the road, a small scab on his chin and chapped hands. Hair: black, tousled, in a short knot with a jade pine-twig pin tilted. Body: stocky, travel-worn, bowed shoulders. Clothing: a travel-dusted but sound robe of grey-green silk over cream, collars crossed twice, a pine-needle border in dark green, a grey-green sash, a wide straw hat hanging at his back, strong boots caked with road dust, a small clay dog-whistle on a green cord, the satchel strap mended with leather thongs. Hands and objects: both arms wrapped round a thick brown leather satchel with brass buckles, no writing; his chin on top of it. Power: a very faint breath of green wood qi, soft as sleep, hangs over the satchel with two or three pale motes. Background: an inn porch with a wooden post and a hanging lantern, a brown dog curled up asleep on the boards, night mist beyond. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left lighting his grin and the brass buckles, a cool silver moonlight rim on his shoulder. Expression: a sleepy, cheerful grin with puffy eyes half open and a flushed cheek creased from the bench.

people.imagined: In the workshop, he hums to the grain as he carves, then stops when he sees he is watched. Shavings curl at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: in a workshop, carving a beam with a small adze, he looks up as if caught humming to the grain, and stops, shavings curling at his feet. Face: a lean, warm, thoughtful face with a straight nose, calm brown eyes, laugh lines, a short dark beard with wood shavings in it and a shy flicker of a smile. Hair: dark brown, in a topknot with a carved jade pine twig, a curl of shaving caught in it. Body: lean and strong in the forearms. Clothing: layered robes of pine-green silk over cream with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves caught up with a leather strap, a needle-green sash, a pale silk work-apron full of shavings with a loop of tool pouches, a narrow chisel stuck behind his ear and a pencil of charcoal in the apron pocket, borders embroidered with pine-needle and grain-curl patterns. Hands and objects: broad hands with square nails and a thumb stained brown with oil; the right holds a small curved adze with a polished wooden handle, the left rests on a half-carved pale beam with a coiling grain pattern. Power: a gentle green wood qi follows the grain, thin ribbons of pale light curling out of the beam with each shaving, a few motes in his beard. Background: a workshop with a big beam on trestles with a half-finished pattern, a saw hanging on the wall, a window of soft light and mist. Light: gold spirit-light from the upper left with wood dust glittering in the beam, lighting the curl of shaving on the blade, a faint green rim on his forearm. Expression: a caught-out, slightly sheepish look, lips just closing off a hum, eyes lifting stubbornly from the beam.

people.imagined: In the market she counts you with her eyes like a woman counting coin, a pleasant smile fixed. She keeps two sets of letters.
people.subject: The moment: in a bright market lane she looks the viewer up and down once, quickly, with a pleasant smile that does not move, counting you with her eyes like a woman counting coin. Face (most important: eyes that count, a steady head-to-toe appraising glance): a handsome, narrow face with level dark eyes that flick, thin finely drawn brows, a high forehead, a small pleasant mouth with a smile set like paint, clear skin, a tiny mole at the lip, small ears with a tiny gold stud in one lobe. Hair: black, in an elegant high coil with a jade pine-twig pin and a small jade bead. Body: slender and composed. Clothing: well-cut layered robes of pine-green silk over pale cream, three crossed collars, wide sleeves lined in pale grey silk, a needle-green sash with a thin silver chain looping from it to a rope purse, borders embroidered with silver pine needles and wind-curls, fine pale silk shoes. Hands and objects: one hand holds a closed bamboo basket; the other rests on the purse, thumb moving on the cord. Power: a faint pale green wood qi, cool and tidy, drifts about her sleeves, with a few small motes catching her gold stud. Background: a bright market of awnings and baskets with bright cloths hung at the stalls, a seller arguing with a customer, all blurred in a soft mist. Light: bright pearly light from the upper left making her pleasant smile look like painted porcelain, a clean rim light along her cheek. Expression: a sweet, fixed smile that does not move, eyes cool and quick as they take the viewer's measure.

people.imagined: She walks as if carrying a full bowl even with empty hands, her master's zither slung heavy at her back; she has noticed it weighs too much.
people.subject: The moment: on a forest path she steps with careful smooth steps, both hands held at belly height as if carrying a full bowl of water, looking at the viewer, her master's zither heavy on her back. Face: a calm, round, gentle face with level brows, steady dark eyes, a slightly furrowed forehead of concentration, pale lips and a small quiet mouth, a faint line between the brows as she balances an imaginary bowl. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a jade pine-twig pin; no loose strands. Body: slight, poised, with the long neck of a dancer. Clothing: clean, exact layered robes of pine-green silk over cream with two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a needle-green sash wound with a plain cord, a long dark strap crossing the chest padded at the shoulder with folded silk, soft felt shoes, borders of pine needles and wind-curls. Hands and objects (the zither is the lead): a long zither wrapped in plain pale silk on her back, one end clearly above the shoulder; both hands curved empty as if holding a bowl. Power: a trembling ripple of pale green wood qi hangs in the air over her curved palms, as if the invisible bowl were full. Background: a forest path of soft green shade, slender trunks, pale fallen leaves on the moss, mist between the trees. Light: dappled spirit-light from the upper left moving across her cheek and the silk of the zither case, a soft green glow from the leaves. Expression: a careful, humble face with lowered lids and a steady, concentrated mouth, eyes lifting shyly to the viewer.

people.imagined: In the paper shed he stands in a drift of birch-bark curls, pressing a sheet flat with the side of his hand; curls cling to every fold.
people.subject: The moment: standing among drying sheets in the paper shed, he looks over his shoulder at the viewer, calm and quiet, pressing one sheet flat with the side of his hand while curls of pale birch bark cling to every fold. Face (most important: pale birch-bark curls clinging to hair, sleeves and shoulders): a pale oval face with a straight nose, faint thin dark brows, calm heavy-lidded eyes, a mild closed mouth and one curl of bark stuck on the cheek and another at the lower lip. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders with a jade pine-twig pin, curls of bark caught in it. Body: slim, soft and stooped slightly. Clothing: layered robes of pine-green silk over cream with two crossed collars, bark curls caught in the folds, the wide sleeves tied with bark string, a needle-green sash with a small flat knife, a long pale silk apron smeared with brown resin and ink, borders embroidered with pine needles and wind-curls. Hands and objects: one hand pressed flat on a pale drying sheet of birch-bark paper, blank; more blank sheets hang behind him on cords. Power: a pale green wood qi drifts softly through the hanging sheets and lifts a few bark curls, as if the paper were breathing. Background: the shed itself, rows of birch-bark sheets hanging from lines, pots of resin in a corner and a sack of curls, drifting mist. Light: soft, almost white spirit-light from the upper left giving the whole picture a papery glow, a pale silver rim on his sleeve. Expression: a quiet, diligent calm, the eyes heavy and the mouth mild, withdrawn and unhurried, a man who has spent his days in this shed and likes it that way.

people.imagined: At the gold-washing landing, sun-dark, with a red thread tied round her wrist. She turns it as she looks at a stranger's face and wonders whom it belongs to.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the water's edge of a gold-washing landing with a shallow pan in her hands, she lifts her head to the viewer, the pan tilted, turning the red thread on her wrist as she wonders whom a stranger's face belongs to. Face (most important: a bright red thread tied round the left wrist, plain against the dark skin): a sun-darkened, lined, strong-boned face, steady black eyes under thin brows, a wide mouth in a careful smile with a small scar at the corner, pale gold specks in the skin at the temples and tiny gold flecks on her cheek. Hair: black, tied up in a scarf of pale silk with a jade pine-twig pin through the knot. Body: small, wiry, strong. Clothing: layered robes of grey-green silk over cream as a steward, two crossed collars, the sleeves rolled to the elbow with bands of cord, a dark wet silk over-apron, a small bag of gold-dust at her belt, borders of ripple-curls and pine needles. Hands and objects: a wide shallow wooden gold-pan with a glitter of gold flecks in wet sand, held in both hands; gold dust in the creases of her knuckles; a red thread tied round the left wrist. Power: a cool pale-blue water qi eddies around the pan and her wrists, tiny gold motes lifting from the sand like fireflies. Background: river shallows with reeds and a line of washers crouching in the water, blurred, a flat-bottomed boat tied up, soft mist. Light: bright pearly river glare from the upper left putting a glow on her face and the gold in the pan, a pale rim along her scarf. Expression: a gentle, soft-edged smile over wary, watchful eyes that study the viewer's face.

people.imagined: In council she speaks to the elders as if across a frozen lake. She wears the ice-cutter's apron and has never sat out a whole meeting.
people.subject: The moment: standing up in a council hall with a fist raised, she calls out loudly to the far side of the room, looking at the viewer, speaking to the elders as if across a frozen lake. Face (most important: a big mouth open in a shout, and a heavy brocade ice-cutter's apron-vest with a rimed edge over broad shoulders): a broad strong face with a wide jaw, a prominent nose, thick straight brows, fierce clear grey eyes, a big open mouth, wind-reddened cheeks, a thick neck and a faint scar of frost-burn across her chin. Hair: black, in a tight thick braid wound round the head, held with a jade pine-twig pin. Body: tall, big-shouldered, powerful. Clothing: heavy layered robes of pine-green silk with a pale cream inner collar and three crossed collars, the wide sleeves rolled up on strong forearms, over them a broad brocade apron-vest in deep green rimmed with frost, a needle-green sash with a big silver buckle, borders embroidered with ripples and pine needles. Hands and objects: the right fist raised; at her belt a small silver ice-hook on a green tassel. Power: a cold pale-blue water qi spreads like a thin white rime across the pillars and her raised fist, pale motes of cold light swirling around her braid. Background: a hall with pale wooden pillars and a line of grey-green-robed elders at the far end, blurred, in a faint mist. Light: bright cold spirit-light from the upper left falling across her raised fist and the frost on her apron, a pale blue rim along her jaw. Expression: a hard, forceful face with an open shouting mouth, brows lowered and eyes blazing across the hall.

people.imagined: He lounges outside the kitchen with a basket of lake fish bought with his sister's allowance, a silver fish scale stuck to his cheek like a beauty mark.
people.subject: The moment: lounging against a kitchen wall, he holds up a string of fish bought with his sister's allowance and grins easily at the viewer. Face (most important: a single bright silver fish scale stuck on the cheekbone like a beauty mark): a round, lazy, cheerful face with a wide easy grin, sleepy dark eyes, a flat nose, a scatter of freckles, a lazy dimple near the mouth and a shining oval scale on the left cheek, round ears. Hair: black, flat and messy, a jade pine twig stuck in at an angle. Body: soft, relaxed, sprawled. Clothing: a plain but graceful robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green outer layer, the collars crossed loosely, no sash, the sleeves rolled and crooked, a fish-scale shimmer on the cuffs, a bit of reed grass sticking from the collar, bare ankles, faint pine-needle embroidery on the border. Hands and objects: a string of four silver lake fish held up in the right hand, glittering. Background: a kitchen doorway with steam, a low wall of stacked baskets and a big pot with a woman's arm showing, soft mist. Light: warm lantern-gold light from the upper left making the fish scales shine like coins, a soft silver rim on his cheek. Expression: an easy, idle grin with half-lidded eyes and a relaxed jaw, a silver fish scale on the cheek.

people.imagined: Crossing the open yard he keeps the low slow stoop of the mine as if the ceiling were still above him.
people.subject: The moment: standing in an open sunlit yard with his head down and his shoulders drawn forward as if under a low roof, he looks up at the viewer with a serious face, keeping the low slow stoop of the mine as if the ceiling were still above him. Face: a square, plain, earnest young face with a broad forehead, heavy brows, small steady grey eyes, a straight stubborn mouth, a short neck, grey rock dust lining the creases of the forehead and ears. Hair: black, short and sticking up. Body: short and thick-shouldered, bent forward at neck and back in a deep miner's stoop. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of pale cream silk under a pine-green outer layer stained grey at the knees and elbows, two crossed collars, no sash, dark silk knee guards sewn on for crawling, strong low boots, a flat cap held in the hand and a small lantern hook at the belt, a narrow pine-needle border. Hands and objects: one hand carries a small cloth bag of bright green stone chips; the other hangs, scarred across the knuckles, cracked and dusty. Background: a bright yard of pale gravel, bare except for a handcart, with a distant pine and a low door in the far wall black with shadow, drifting pale mist. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left casting soft shadows under his brow, a pale silver rim on his shoulder. Expression: a stubborn, honest seriousness, the brows low and the mouth flat, a diligent boy who has not yet learned that the sky is allowed to be above him.

people.imagined: He taps the tiger-claw charm at his throat as he says the word tiger. He has never seen a tiger; the one he saw was a dog.
people.subject: The moment: in a training yard, tapping a charm at his throat with one finger, he looks at the viewer with a bold, boastful grin as he says the word tiger. Face (most important: a curved yellow tiger-claw charm on a cord at the throat): a handsome, proud, cocky face with a straight high nose, thick dark brows, a strong jaw, bright confident eyes, a quick white grin with even teeth and a small gold ring in one ear. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a green silk cord and a jade pine-twig pin. Body: well built, upright, a little swaggering. Clothing: a tailored inner-disciple robe of pine-green silk over cream with two crossed collars and silver stitching along the collar, a needle-green sash with a neat jade pine-cone pendant, a lacquered bracer carved with a tiger pattern on the left forearm, borders of pine needles and wind-curls. Hands and objects: the right forefinger tapping a large curved yellow-white claw on a leather cord at his neck. Power: a keen pale green wood qi sparks about his shoulders, a few bright motes flicking up when he taps the claw. Background: a yard of swept earth with a rack of wooden practice swords and dark pines beyond, morning mist. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left gleaming on the claw and on his gold earring, a clean rim along his jaw. Expression: a bold, boastful grin with raised chin and bright, overconfident eyes.

people.imagined: Standing in her aunt's ferry with the oar over her shoulder, calling out the fare before anyone has asked, freckles to the hairline.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a small ferry boat with an oar across her shoulders, mouth open calling out the fare before anyone has asked, one palm held out for coin. Face (most important: freckles thick from nose to hairline, a bold open mouth, the palm out for payment): a round, bright, sun-freckled face with freckles so thick they join into blotches and reach the hairline, wide hazel eyes, quick arched brows, a pointed chin, a snub nose and a cheeky wide mouth mid-call, a smile that is all business. Hair: red-brown, in two braids tied up with green silk cord and a small jade pine twig. Body: small, strong and quick, the sleeves rolled. Clothing: a plain graceful jerkin of pine-green silk over cream with two crossed collars, a needle-green sash, loose trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet and a wet hem, the sleeves tied up with silk cord, a small knife in a sheath and a string of copper coins at the belt, borders of wave-curls. Hands and objects: the left palm held out flat in front of her; the right hand grips a long oar resting across her shoulders. Background: a wide river with reeds and water lilies lining the bank and a pale line of distant roofs on the far shore, mist rising from the water. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left sparkling on the water and making her freckles look like gold dust, a soft pale rim along her braids. Expression: a cheerful, gregarious haggling grin, chin up and eyes dancing, a girl who enjoys the price almost as much as the passage.

people.imagined: He sniffs the air before rain, flood rod in hand, and is right; the village children call him Muddy Jaw and he answers.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a tall rod, his chin lifted and nostrils flared, he sniffs the air before rain and glances at the viewer, sure he is right. Face (most important: a very long jaw, blotchy skin, and ears set too low and sticking out): a plain, long, awkward face with a long blotchy red-and-pale jaw, dark blotches running into the neck, a big nose lifted into the air, low flaring ears, small mild eyes, thin uneven brows, a tight patient mouth and a few stray hairs on the upper lip; not made handsome. Hair: brown, cut straight and short, with a jade pine-twig pin in a stubby tail. Body: lanky, narrow-chested, long-necked. Clothing: a clean pine-green silk robe over cream, a little short in the arms, two crossed collars, a plain silk rope belt, a straw rain-cape mended with new yellow straw folded over one shoulder, a small notebook of wooden slats at the belt, borders of wave-curls and pine needles. Hands and objects: both hands hold a tall flood-mark rod banded with dark paint, the end planted in mud; his head tilted back. Power: a thin pale-blue water qi stirs in the grass at his feet and gathers on the rod's rings before the rain, a few silver motes in the air. Background: a dike of long grasses bending in the wind, a line of numbered stakes, a heavy pearl-grey sky with a darker cloud approaching and a flock of birds flying low. Light: grey storm-light from the upper left turning the grass silver and showing the paleness of his skin, a pale rim on his jaw. Expression: a calm, unbothered face with flared nostrils and a steady sidelong glance, the mouth quietly amused.

people.imagined: She lights the dusk incense stick when her mother's hands shake, a small pale mark on her cheek where a censer spark once landed.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim incense hall she bends slightly and touches a glowing taper to a thin incense stick, looking up at the viewer in the light of it, lighting the dusk stick because her mother's hands shake. Face (most important: a small round pale scar on the left cheek, the size of a lentil, from a censer spark): a soft, sweet, oval face with a gentle chin, clear dark soft eyes with long lashes and a faint tint of smoke shadowing the lids, softly arched brows, a small mouth lifted at one corner and a pale round mark on the cheek. Hair: black, in a long braid over one shoulder with a green ribbon and a jade pine-twig pin. Body: slim, graceful, bent forward. Clothing: a graceful robe of pine-green silk over pale cream with two crossed collars, a needle-green sash, wide sleeves caught up with a green silk cord, a tiny brass censer-bell on the sash, a thin grey scarf of gauze curling about her like smoke, borders of pine needles and drifting smoke-curls. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a slender stick with a glowing red tip; the left holds a tiny brass taper with a flame. Power: the incense smoke curls into soft green wood qi around her fingers, a few warm ember motes rising. Background: shelves of brass censers and bundles of unlit sticks behind her, a low window letting in a shaft of moonlight, soft smoke. Light: warm taper glow from the lower right lighting her cheek and the pale mark, soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle haze of smoke. Expression: a quiet, content smile with soft, lowered eyes lit by the taper, the face calm and gentle.

people.imagined: At midwinter, wet from the sea, salt crusted on his eyebrows, he stands unshivering where the keepers turned back.
people.subject: The moment: standing wet and bare-armed on a winter shore at midwinter, he looks calmly at the viewer, unshivering where the keepers turned back. Face (most important: white salt crust frosting both eyebrows, and wet hair with no shiver): a calm, square, tanned face with thick brows white with dried salt, steady dark eyes, a wide straight mouth with lips gone blue from cold, a small scar on the chin, pale salt dried at the temples and white crystals lining his lashes and hairline. Hair: black, plastered wet to the skull. Body: stocky, strong, relaxed shoulders, bare forearms. Clothing: a layered robe of pine-green silk over cream soaked dark and clinging, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, the seams bleached white with salt, a needle-green sash heavy with water and wound with cord, a small knife at the belt, bare feet in cold surf, faint wave and pine-needle embroidery on the borders. Hands and objects: both arms hang loose; a small cord with a white shell at the throat. Power: a cold pale-blue water qi coils in slow rings round his calves and shoulders, breath hanging in a faint cloud with a few silver motes. Background: a grey winter sea and a white horizon, waves breaking in lines of white foam on dark sand, a few gulls hanging in the misty air. Light: cold silver moonlit light from the upper left, flat and clear, a pale blue rim along his shoulder. Expression: a calm face as still as stone, wet lashes and unshivering lips, eyes level and unafraid.

people.imagined: She wipes her hands on her hair, as always; the broom stands taller than her. She has learned forty recipes by listening at the door.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a broom much taller than herself, she wipes her palms on her hair, as she always does, and looks at the viewer with a bright, hungry eagerness; she has learned forty recipes by listening at the door. Face (most important: a broom twice her height standing at her side): a small, thin, bright, freckled face with big dark eyes, a pointed chin, a quick sly smile, dust on the cheek and strands of hair stuck up from being wiped. Hair: dark brown, a bit greasy and tufted, tied in a small knot with a cord and a small jade pine twig. Body: tiny and wiry, a little over-quick, standing on her toes. Clothing: a clean, simple robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green outer layer, plain cuffs, two crossed collars, no sash, and a pale silk apron gone grey with ash, a thin border of pine needles. Hands and objects: a tall broom of bundled twigs at least a head taller than she is, held upright in one hand while the other wipes her hair; a small copper-lidded jar hangs at her belt. Background: a corridor of a furnace room with a faint red glow behind a half-open door, shelves of jars in shadow, a thread of pale mist. Light: warm glow from behind the door mixing with silver spirit-light from the upper left, rimming her tufted hair. Expression: a bright, hungry, humble eagerness with a touch of greed in the sidelong glance, the look of a clever girl who knows how much she has learned and how little anyone has noticed.

people.imagined: Asked a question, he stands blinking, the answer still walking toward him; he is better at the chores than the primer.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a woodcutters' yard with an armful of firewood, he looks at the viewer with a slow, patient blink, mouth just beginning to open, asked a question to which the answer is still walking toward him. Face: a broad, open, placid face with wide-set brown eyes, thick brows raised mildly, a plain round nose, a slightly slack mouth with chapped lips, big low ears, a bit of bark on the brow and a look of kind blankness. Hair: black, short and shaggy, with a bit of bark and a jade pine twig in it. Body: broad, solid and tall for his age, a country boy better at chores than the primer. Clothing: a plain, clean robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green outer layer, two crossed collars, the sleeves rolled and no sash, the elbows polished pale and wood-chip dust on the front, a plain silk rope belt and a soft grey scarf wound twice round the neck, a thin pine-needle border. Hands and objects: both arms around a bundle of split pine firewood, the bark pale and rough, with an axe stuck through his belt. Power: none drawn, only a faint green mote or two drifting from the fresh-split pine. Background: a woodpile reaching to the roof of a shed with a pile of chips in front, a small brown dog nearby and a distant hill with pines in mist. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left lying on his broad face like a blessing, a pale rim along his shoulder. Expression: a delayed, gentle look, the eyes steady and the mouth just parting, brave and honest and content, entirely without hurry.
